dependency_scope: Selected direct semantic dependencies, not the full transitive closure.
scope: All 45 existing raw candidate components for genus two with one marking; homogeneous realization and connected degree-zero projection; conditional agreement with the existing fixed-point TFT unit correlator.

findings.issue: Basiswise graded realization did not expose the span-level degree lemma or positive-degree scalar vanishing needed by actual raw expressions.
findings.correction: Derive both in the upward StrataRealizationDegree module using existing linear and graded APIs.

findings.issue: No assembly theorem connected all 45 accepted raw components to the canonical TFT normalization.
findings.correction: Assemble all components; identify the actual fundamental degree-zero component and derive the scalar formula with explicit hfund and h00.

findings.issue: The initial staged proof left two conditional expressions unreduced and listed five unused simp arguments.
findings.correction: Two explicit conditional rewrites and deletion of unused arguments; definitions and theorem statements unchanged.

review_conclusion: No remaining defect found in this targeted accepted algebraic scope; no comprehensive geometry or repository review is claimed.

mathematical_effect.fundamental_component: raw_0_0_degree0 equals the existing fundamental basis vector; the other eight degree-zero components are zero.
mathematical_effect.tft_formula: If coeff(p,0,0) = euler(p), then scalar(assembly A coeff) equals the canonical genus-two, one-marked unit correlator.
mathematical_effect.positive_degree_behavior: Components are retained in the class expression; only their connected degree-zero projections vanish.
mathematical_effect.coefficient_grading: Stable-curve codimension over the coefficient field; scalar coefficients have relative degree zero.

explicit_inputs: A field K with Algebra QQ K and a supplied StableCurveCohomology K.
A supplied ConnectedDegreeZero structure and degree-preserving rational StrataRealization.
hfund: realization of the fundamental basis vector equals one; this is necessary and is not derived from StrataRealization alone.
Supplied coefficients, a finite fixed-point index type, and invertible Euler weights.
h00: every supplied (0,0) coefficient equals its Euler weight; this remains conditional in this record.
